disclaimer_ja: These are not results from an actual Microsoft Foundry Agent Optimizer (Portal wizard) run. The instructor manually created fictional values to illustrate the comparisons in labs/06-optimization.md: candidate scores against the baseline and criteria for promote/keep decisions. Agent Optimizer operates entirely through the Portal wizard and has no script JSON output, so this file is a reference structure modeled on the wizard results screen.

candidates.instructions_diff_summary_ja: Explicitly added to the instructions: the citation format for source documents, a standard refusal for out-of-scope questions, and criteria for deciding when to use per diem and estimation tools.
Excessive simplification of the instructions weakened evidence presentation for questions spanning multiple documents compared with the baseline.

recommendation.rationale_ja: candidate-01 clearly improves the composite score to 0.62 from the baseline (0.41), with every per-evaluator dimension at or above baseline. candidate-02 is below baseline and is not promoted.
